description: Machine copy of the word lists of HyperSVG 2.0: roles and their schemas, drawing marks, allowed SVG, portable file names, colour roles, standard shapes, keys and cue letters. Where this file and the section text differ, the section text decides.

movingBits.rule: any plain word; valid, and reported (W-ROLE-UNKNOWN) until a kit lists it

placement.part: an element or <g> inside a component or a screen drawing
placement.component: the top-level <g> of a component drawing, or a <g> in a screen drawing
placement.screen: the root <svg> of a screen drawing

value.note: one role word, then a side (left, right as the viewer sees it; near, far); or protected-area words on an unpainted <rect>: keep-inside, keep-clear, keep-empty, or keep-inside with keep-clear; decoration is ornament screen readers skip (D35)
plain text, the part's name for people
x y, two finite decimal numbers

draw.requires: pathLength="1" on the element, a stroked <path>, <circle>, <ellipse>, <line>, <polyline>, <polygon> or <rect>
draw.note: the drawn share of the line's length (the binding word draw, 6.8)

wipe.note: the share of the part shown, from the left (6.7)

value.note: the local id of its leader part

roles.kit: any other id-grammar word a kit theme defines
any other id-grammar word a kit theme defines

value.note: a theme text style for a text (heading, body, caption, or a kit's own, D37); a <g> passes it down
the slot's name; an empty <g> or an unpainted <rect>
the box a text stays inside: no value or text; items: a layout plan's box (the layout add-on); video: a video's box. The box may be painted (D38).
any value, or none: a group whose child slots hold one item each

on.note: each look: a direct child <g> of a part with looks

value.note: the look name; the rest look is the one shown (no display="none")

markAliases.note: Readable in 2.0 drawings without an upgrade; writers never write them.

data-hsvg-states.note: the look names come from the look children; checked to agree

data-hsvg-state.note: the rest look is the look shown without display="none"

optional: width and height for an exact size

hostPageMarks.note: Marks on a host page, never in a drawing (E-MARK-UNKNOWN in a drawing).

earlierMarks.note: earlier spellings of data-hsvg-hook; the upgrade tool converts them at import, the reader does not read them, and a drawing may not carry them

toolData.note: data-<tool>-*: never read by players, never data-hsvg-

svgAttributes.classNote: class is inert: no stylesheet reads it
svgAttributes.rule: an attribute that is in none of these lists, the marks or toolData is refused (E-SVG-UNSAFE); styleOnly and styleRootOnly name style properties, not attributes: they count only inside a style attribute (styleRootOnly on the root only)

svgRefused.elementRule: any element not in svgElements.all is refused; HTML elements included
otherRefused: processing instructions (the XML declaration is allowed)

svgLimits.addresses: href on <use> and every url(...) is a local #id; href on <image> is a data: URI of an image type or the relative path of a declared image resource; no other scheme

css.only: style attributes with plain declarations of the presentation properties, svgAttributes.styleOnly and, on the root, svgAttributes.styleRootOnly

allowed.note: precomposed Latin and Greek letters; every accepted sequence is already NFC; combining marks and every other character fail (including 1C89 and 105C0); a runtime's Unicode categories never enlarge the set

caseFold.appliedTo: every member path and every directory prefix; two paths with one key collide

portableNames.reservedMatch: after the case fold, a whole segment or a segment before its first dot (with or without an extension)
refuse: a file that is also another file's parent
one directory prefix written with two spellings

colorRoles.kitRoles: other roles a kit theme defines (7.7): id grammar, never a core name

typeRoles.kitRoles: other type roles a kit theme defines (7.7): id grammar, never a core name

standardShapes.aspect: width / height; minimums inclusive, maximums exclusive

keys.note: Tab and Escape are never control keys (5.11); there is no repeated keydown

cueLetters.note: mouth.cues maps all nine letters to look names of the mouth part

toolRecord.on: a direct child of the root <svg>; at most one

steps.note: the give-way steps a bake took for this derived frame, in the order taken: <rule id>:<step>, once per time, space-separated; written by the packer

asset.note: a HyperSVG's record (D45, 2.13, 10.14): format, id, drawing, members and files; written by pack --asset, read by unpack and the asset player, which check it (src/asset.mjs)
